description:
Create a technical Solar PV Single Line Diagram (SLD) for a residential installation.

A system specification file is provided on the Desktop at '~/Desktop/solar_specifications.txt'.

Your task is to:
1. Read the specifications to identify the hardware chain (PV Modules -> Combiner -> Disconnects -> Inverter -> Service Panel -> Meter -> Grid).
2. Create a Single Line Diagram in draw.io using appropriate Electrical symbols (enable the 'Electrical' shape library or use standard flow shapes if necessary).
3. Label every component with the specific Manufacturer, Model Number, and Electrical Ratings provided in the text file.
4. Connect the components with lines to show the flow of power from generation (PV) to the Utility Grid.
5. Save the source file as '~/Desktop/solar_sld.drawio'.
6. Export the diagram as a PNG image to '~/Desktop/solar_sld.png'.

CRITICAL: The diagram must include the specific model numbers (e.g. 'SE7600H-US', 'Q.PEAK DUO') and show the complete path from modules to grid.
